'''Rolan Aun''' was a [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] who accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denolm Orr]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] to investigate a link between the planet and [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Mission Abstract">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref> He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with the rest of the team.<ref name="TOR" />
